beats.headline: NVDA drops 4.16% amid broader semiconductor selloff
beats.explanation: NVIDIA fell 4.16% to close at $171.24 on 1.5x average volume. The decline was largely sector-wide, as peers AMD dropped 7.49% and TSM dropped 6.22% on the same day.

beats.headline: NVDA gains 4.32% in sector-wide rally
beats.explanation: NVIDIA climbed 4.32% to $208.27 on 1.8x its 30-day average volume. The gain coincided with a broad semiconductor advance, with AMD jumping 13.91% and TSM rising 5.17%.

beats.headline: NVDA gains 4.00% following Form 8-K filing

beats.headline: NVDA declines 4.63% despite strength in peers

beats.explanation: NVIDIA rose 5.77% to $207.83 on 1.6x average volume. The move was part of a broader sector upswing, with AMD surging 18.61% and TSM adding 6.36%.

beats.headline: NVDA advances 6.26% outperforming peers
beats.explanation: NVIDIA climbed 6.26% to $224.36 on 1.8x average volume with no specific company announcements provided. While TSM rose 4.11%, AMD dropped 1.16%, indicating strong relative performance.

beats.headline: NVDA drops 3.62% as peer performance diverges
beats.explanation: NVIDIA fell 3.62% to $214.75 on 1.3x average volume. The drop was largely company-specific given mixed peer performance, as AMD gained 4.02% while TSM dropped 2.24%.

beats.headline: NVDA drops 6.20% in broad semiconductor pullback
beats.explanation: NVIDIA declined 6.20% to $205.10 on 1.8x average volume. The drop was sector-wide, tracking steep drops in peers AMD (-10.86%) and TSM (-6.69%).

beats.headline: NVDA rises 4.03% to $210.96
beats.explanation: NVIDIA rose 4.03% to $210.96 on 1.2x average volume without company-specific news. Peers saw muted moves, with AMD rising 2.04% and TSM slipping 0.65%.

beats.headline: NVDA gains 3.44% diverging from chip peers
beats.explanation: NVIDIA gained 3.44% to $219.22 on 1.3x typical volume. This was a company-specific advance against weak peer action, as AMD dropped 7.04% and TSM fell 0.76%.

beats.headline: NVDA jumps 8.74% following 10-Q and 8-K filings
beats.explanation: NVIDIA surged 8.74% to $227.98 on 2.5x average trading volume following 10-Q and 8-K filings on August 26. The move was company-specific, as peer AMD fell 0.89% and TSM gained 2.30%.

beats.headline: NVDA adds 3.21% to close at $224.41
beats.explanation: NVIDIA rose 3.21% to $224.41 on 1.3x average volume with no company-specific catalysts reported. The stock decoupled from peers AMD (-0.56%) and TSM (+0.36%).

arc: Between March and September 2026, NVIDIA navigated repeated bouts of sector-wide semiconductor volatility while gradually appreciating from $171.24 to $224.41. Several of the largest daily swings, such as the drops on March 26 and June 5, directly tracked broader industry moves in peers like AMD and TSM. However, the stock increasingly decoupled from its peer group in the late summer, culminating in a significant 8.74% rally on August 27 following its second-quarter SEC filings.
